extracted.intended_audience: CIA directorate heads and office budget/reporting staff (e.g., Directors of Communications, Finance, Logistics, Medical Services, Personnel, Security, Training, Chief Support Services Staff)
extracted.subtask_description: Internal CIA implementation instructions for preparing and submitting reports required by OMB Circular A-44 (Revised), specifying required sections, reporting periods, deadlines, destination, and scope limitation to each office's budget.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initial report time period
rubrics_metrics.description: The first report ... should include nothing at all regarding FY 1970. ... the report covers the period of time between 1 January and 30 June 1971.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit an initial report that covers only 1 Jan–30 Jun 1971; explicitly exclude FY 1970 data because it was not included in the last budget.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initial report required sections
rubrics_metrics.description: Please note that Section I, 'Management Effectiveness Goals,' and Section II, 'Cost Reduction Goals,' are the only sections to be included in the initial report.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When preparing the initial submission include only Section I (Management Effectiveness Goals) and Section II (Cost Reduction Goals); do not include Sections III or IV in this initial filing.

rubrics_metrics.name: First full report timing and coverage
rubrics_metrics.description: The first full report will be submitted so as to reach the Executive Director-Comptroller on 30 June 1971. This report will contain all four sections and will cover the period 1 July 1971 - 30 June 1972.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare a full annual report covering 1 Jul 1971–30 Jun 1972, include all four sections specified by the Circular, and ensure it is routed to/received by the Executive Director–Comptroller by 30 June 1971.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope limited to Office budget
rubrics_metrics.description: Your reports should be limited to your own Office's budget. This is necessary in order to avoid confusion as to who claims what savings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report only savings, costs, and goals attributable to your own office; do not include cross-office budgets or attempt to claim savings for other organizational units.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standardized form and instructions for full report
rubrics_metrics.description: A form and set of instructions will be prepared for the 30 June 1971 report.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expect and use the forthcoming standardized form/instructions for the 30 June 1971 full report to ensure uniformity across offices; await distribution before finalizing format if possible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adherence to deadlines / amendment note
rubrics_metrics.description: This amends our memorandum, same subject, dated 13 November 1970. The deadline remains 14 December 1970.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note that this memorandum modifies a prior memo (13 Nov 1970) and that affected deadlines should be observed (the memo states the deadline remains 14 Dec 1970). Reconcile any apparent date references in this memo (e.g., 21 Dec vs. 14 Dec) with existing instructions and comply with the stated deadline(s).

rubrics_metrics.name: Future integration into normal budget submittals (aspiration)
rubrics_metrics.description: It is hoped that the reporting instructions can, at some future date, be modified to permit inclusion of the information called for in the annual report in the normal budget 'submittals.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be aware that reporting procedures may later change to allow inclusion of these data within regular budget submissions; plan record-keeping so data can be integrated into standard budget submittals if/when directed.
